name: Carmine (Cochineal)
note: A red dye made by crushing cochineal beetles. Not vegan.

name: Lanolin
note: Grease extracted from sheep's wool. Not vegan.

name: Gelatin
note: Made by boiling the skin, bones and connective tissue of cattle or pigs. Not vegan.

name: Collagen
note: A protein taken from animal skin, bones, tendons or connective tissue - usually cattle, pigs or fish. Not vegan.

name: Keratin
note: A protein taken from animal hair, horns, feathers or hooves. Not vegan.

name: Elastin
note: A protein taken from the neck ligaments and aortas of cattle. Not vegan.

name: Shellac
note: A resin secreted by the female lac beetle. Not vegan.

name: Beeswax
note: Wax secreted by honeybees to build their honeycomb. Not vegan.

name: Honey
note: Made by bees from flower nectar. Not vegan.

name: Royal Jelly
note: A secretion produced by worker honeybees to feed larvae and the queen. Not vegan.

name: Propolis
note: A resin-like substance bees make from plant sap and their own secretions. Not vegan.

name: Tallow
note: Rendered fat from cattle or sheep. Not vegan.

name: Lard
note: Rendered fat from pigs. Not vegan.

name: Casein
note: A protein extracted from cow's milk. Not vegan.

name: Whey
note: A by-product of cow's milk left over from cheesemaking. Not vegan.

name: Lactose
note: Milk sugar, extracted from cow's milk. Not vegan.

name: Albumin
note: A protein from egg white (occasionally blood plasma). Not vegan.

name: Egg
note: Made from chicken eggs. Not vegan.

name: Milk
note: From cows, goats or sheep. Not vegan.

name: Guanine (Pearl Essence)
note: A shimmer additive scraped from fish scales. Not vegan.

name: Ambergris
note: A waxy substance from sperm whale intestines, used in perfume. Not vegan.

name: Musk
note: Traditionally taken from the scent glands of musk deer. Modern fragrance almost always uses synthetic substitutes, but check if unspecified. Not vegan.

name: Civet
note: Taken from the scent glands of civet cats. Not vegan.

name: Silk
note: Made from the cocoons of silkworms. Not vegan.

name: Chitosan
note: Usually made from shellfish shells - crab, shrimp or lobster. Not vegan.

name: Spermaceti
note: Waxy oil found in the head cavities of sperm whales. Now largely banned/replaced, but still worth flagging if the label uses the old name. Not vegan.

name: Squalene
note: Traditionally extracted from shark liver oil. ("Squalane"/"phytosqualane" - with an a - are usually plant-derived instead.) Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Glycerin
note: Usually made from plant oils today, but can also be rendered from animal fat - the label alone can't tell you which. Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Stearic Acid
note: Usually made from palm or soy oil today, but historically and sometimes still rendered from cattle or pig fat. Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Cetyl/Stearyl Alcohol
note: Usually made from plant oils (coconut/palm) today, but can be made from animal fats. Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Lecithin
note: Usually from soy or sunflower today, but can also come from egg yolk. Check the brand's vegan claim if it doesn't say "soy lecithin" or "sunflower lecithin".

name: Vitamin D3
note: Usually made from lanolin (sheep's wool grease) or fish oil. ("Vitamin D2"/ergocalciferol is plant-derived instead.) Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Retinol
note: Can be synthesised or sourced from animal liver/fish oil. Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Oleic Acid
note: Usually from plant oils today, but can be rendered from animal fat. Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Allantoin
note: Usually synthesised or from comfrey plants today, but can be extracted from cattle urine. Check the brand's vegan claim.

name: Hyaluronic Acid
note: Modern versions are usually fermented (vegan), but older/cheaper versions can be extracted from rooster combs or animal connective tissue. Check the brand's vegan claim.
